view: Frontal chest radiograph, probable AP projection (high clavicles, mildly lordotic), arms down at the sides, scapulae partly overlying the upper lateral lung fields
technical_quality: Limited: low inspiratory volume with elevated hemidiaphragms (right higher than left), large body habitus with dense breast and chest-wall soft-tissue shadows obscuring both lower zones and costophrenic angles; no significant rotation (medial clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes); upper thorax adequately penetrated (spine visible through the upper mediastinum) but the lower zones are relatively underpenetrated; a reversed lead marker ('DMD') is present in the upper corner on the patient's left, no L/R marker seen

devices.type: small linear metallic density (~0.5 cm), probable surgical clip versus external artifact; no other clips, sternotomy wires, lines or tubes
devices.location: left mid-to-lower zone, projected at the left heart border / paracardiac region
upper corner of the film on the patient's left, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Small well-defined, dense, rounded nodule approx 0.5 cm, medial/paramediastinal, just above the right hilum; high density and sharp margin favour a calcified granuloma, but a small solid pulmonary nodule cannot be excluded on this film
One or two additional tiny dense dots (approx 0.2 cm) along the medial right lung between the upper nodule and the right hilum, probably small calcified granulomas or vessels end-on
Linear metallic density approx 0.5 cm projected over the left heart border (surgical clip versus external artifact)
Prominent, unfolded/ectatic aortic arch bulging into the left upper mediastinum, consistent with age-related aortic unfolding; trachea midline

Low lung volumes with elevated hemidiaphragms (right higher than left) and basal vascular crowding; both lower zones and costophrenic angles are largely obscured by dense breast/soft-tissue shadows, so a small effusion or basal opacity cannot be confidently excluded
Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal / borderline enlarged (CTR approx 0.5), likely exaggerated by AP projection and low inspiration

description_zh: 胸部正面（疑似AP）攝影，吸氣量不足、雙側橫膈上抬（右側較高），且因體型肥胖與乳房軟組織陰影，雙下肺野及肋膈角評估受限。右上肺野內側、右肺門上方見一約0.5公分邊緣清楚之高密度圓形結節，以鈣化肉芽腫為優先考量，惟小型肺結節無法完全排除；右肺內側另見數個更小之點狀高密度影。左心緣旁見一約0.5公分線狀金屬密度影（手術夾或體外異物），主動脈弓突出迂曲，心影大小於正常上限（AP投影、低肺容積下可能放大）；未見氣胸或明顯肺實質浸潤，亦無胸管或引流管。
